lines: Hrr. The crate-finder. Sit, look, touch even — you have earned handling privileges.
You did a thing for me and did not name a price after. I remember this the way I remember debts. Better, even.
The stall does well today. When the stall does well, the tribe does well. That is all the economics you need.
Good — you. Come stand by the stall; you make the other customers braver. They think if you have not been bitten yet, they will not be.
I sold honey-bread this morning and thought, that one would like this. So. There is a piece behind the counter. Do not tell the Watch I do favorites.
You listen the way Gnolls listen. Whole ears. It is rarer in this city than good wool, and wool does not walk up to my stall twice a week.

hub_options.text: You said the necklace was a promise.
hub_options._flag: CANON ⚑ — the spellbook plan (wiki/Krshia_Silverfang: 10 years collecting for the Meeting of Tribes). Copy stays OBLIQUE, never says 'spellbook'. User gates naming it. heard_krshia_plans is a NEW counter, banked on THIS option (effects live on options, never nodes — house shape).

krshia_tribe.speaker: Krshia
krshia_tribe.text: My tribe, yes. Plains east and south of here — many hearths, one name. A Gnoll in a city is still her tribe's Gnoll; the distance changes nothing that matters. The necklace is not decoration. It is a promise I carry.

krshia_tribe_two.speaker: Krshia
krshia_tribe_two.text: Hrr. Ask me when you have known me longer than one crate. A promise spoken cheap gets spent cheap — this is true of coin and truer of words.

krshia_plans.speaker: Krshia
krshia_plans.text: So you remembered. Hrr. Then hear a little of it. Every coin this stall clears past its keep goes toward something for the tribes — something Gnolls have been told we cannot have, and are done being told. There is a gathering, some years off. I mean to stand up at it with full hands. That stays between you, me, and the wool.

options.text: Full hands. I'd like to see that.

krshia_plans_two.speaker: Krshia
krshia_plans_two.text: You will, if the city behaves and the thieves stay bored. And since you are now a keeper of Silverfang business — for you, the front-of-stall price is the back-of-stall price. Do not announce it.
